# KPATEI Concept & Build

> Architecture and construction company in Freetown, Sierra Leone. "You imagine, we draft it." CEO and Lead Architect: Samuel Amara.

Address: Upper Furniture Junction, Allen Town, Freetown, Sierra Leone
Phone / WhatsApp: +232 78 646 003
Email: chiefkpatei@gmail.com
Website: https://www.kpateiconceptandbuild.com/

## Services
- Permit-ready house plans and building plans (full packages clients use to get building permits): bungalows, duplexes, villas and mansions, apartments, commercial plazas and offices, minimalist homes and extensions, schools, factories and estates.
- 3D realistic videos of the finished building, inside and out, before construction starts.
- Full-scale construction supervision with certified building contractors.
- Diaspora remote project management: for Sierra Leoneans living abroad, with day-to-day site photo and video updates and a private online Client Portal (progress, live site video, approvals, documents).
- Interior design: space planning, styling and complete interior transformations.
- Kpatei EcoFlush biodigester toilet: a sealed system that never needs emptying, has no bad smell and protects wells. Designed, supplied and installed by KPATEI. Details: https://www.kpateiconceptandbuild.com/ecoflush/

## Prices (New Leones, NLe)
- Bungalow house plan (1 floor): NLe 20 per square metre of floor area
- Duplex or house with 2 or more floors: NLe 25 per square metre
- Schools, offices, factories, estates and other large buildings: NLe 30 per square metre
- 3D realistic video: from NLe 1,500, depending on the building
- Payment: invoice for every agreed job; 50% before work starts, 50% on completion.

## Where we work
All of Sierra Leone, including Freetown, Waterloo, Bo, Makeni and Kenema. Clients abroad are welcome.
